## Failure mode

A gateway process without an explicit database URL can resolve its operator-state reads through the desktop discovery file at `~/.papercusp/embedded-pg.json`. Booting a separate desktop rewrites that file with another live Postgres endpoint. A restart can therefore replace the fleet account pool with an unrelated desktop pool while `/healthz` and database maintenance still report success. Liveness checks cannot distinguish two healthy databases.

On 2026-10-07, a coordinated gateway restart loaded one Codex and four Claude accounts from embedded Postgres on port 23325, whereas `accounts:list` on the fleet operator returned eight Codex and nine Claude accounts in the same workspace. Pinning the gateway to the fleet native Postgres endpoint on port 5432 restored the complete pool. The connection layer may route that native endpoint through PgBouncer; that is independent of desktop discovery.

## Durable correction

The managed systemd template explicitly sets `HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL` to its native fleet database. Existing installations need an equivalent service drop-in, or an explicit deployment-specific URL when their operator uses another endpoint. Do not copy accounts between databases or change workspace IDs to conceal an endpoint mismatch.

After daemon-reload, use the coordinated `dev:restart` gateway target and probe readiness before sending inference traffic. Compare `/stats` account counts with the operator pool, then wait through a pool-reload interval and check the DB operation status. A ready HTTP listener alone is insufficient evidence.

The launch-parity regression asserts the template retains the database pin. Live verification restored all eight Codex and nine Claude accounts, completed a `gpt-6.1-sol` request through `aviynw2_codex`, and observed a successful pool reload with no DB failures. Model refusals and invalid refresh credentials remain separate per-account conditions; restoring the correct pool does not renew those credentials.

See [embedded-PG discovery](/internal/docs/agent-insights/embedded-pg-discovery) for the resolution chain.
